tools.name: extract
tools.description: Fetch a public HTTP(S) page and return compact extraction signals for programmatic inspection: title, meta description, Open Graph/Twitter metadata, JSON-LD, headings, links, text excerpt, and AI-readiness flags. Use `read` instead when you need the page body as LLM-ready Markdown rather than metada

tools.name: read
tools.description: Fetch a public HTTP(S) page and return its readable body as cleaned Markdown for LLM context, preserving headings, links, and lists while dropping navigation, ads, scripts, headers, footers, asides, and forms. Use `extract` instead when you need metadata, JSON-LD, Open Graph/Twitter tags, or a link

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Static supply-chain security scan of a public GitHub repo before an agent installs/runs it. Flags exfil sinks, obfuscation, credential reads, install-time curl|bash. risk=clean|suspicious|dangerous.

tools.name: opportunity_preflight
tools.description: Agent work opportunity -> deterministic attempt, verify-first, or abandon preflight using caller-supplied cost and selection assumptions plus dated platform evidence. Returns break-even probability, expected surplus, hard gates, and source-linked evidence. No claim, bid, payment, or submission.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deep_audit, payment_offer_preflight · Private data: scan, schemaforge, enrich, wallet_enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay, agent_discoverability_audit, payment_offer_preflight · Public sink: schemaforge, enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay · Destructive: extract, deep_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deep_audit, payment_offer_preflight · Private data: scan, schemaforge, enrich, wallet_enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay, agent_discoverability_audit, payment_offer_preflight · Public sink: schemaforge, enrich, deep_audit, morpho_position, morpho_protection, morpho_preliquidation_replay · Destructive: extract, deep_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
